verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships AI features such as Rovo, an AI code reviewer and AI pipeline workflows, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows Bitbucket can connect to or consume external MCP servers. The Atlassian MCP server is the server role, which is a separate story, and generic partner integrations are only an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
